description: "The Works of the Right Honourable John, Earl of Rochester" by Rochester is a collection of satirical poems, songs, translations, and occasional verses written in the early 18th century.
longDescription: This work showcases Rochester's sharp wit and critique of social norms, particularly surrounding themes such as marriage, love, and human nature.

authorInfo.bio:
Rochester, John Wilmot, Earl of, (1647–1680) wrote The Works of the Right Honourable John, Earl of Rochester
Consisting of Satires, Songs, Translations, and other Occasional Poems. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
